sentence: Whether key account managers take up AI at all depends on their personality traits, and organizational culture moderates the agreeableness path
passage: [Mehta et al. (2025), p. 543] "Our research shows that key account managers' adoption of AI technologies is influenced significantly by personality traits." / "Organisational culture significantly moderates the association between agreeableness and the adoption of AI technologies."

gemini.note: The passage states that AI adoption is significantly influenced by personality traits, which is a weaker claim than stating that taking up AI 'at all depends' on them.
